## Source Messages

#### <span style="color: #404040;">301 - Source analysis validations (mol% normalized)</span>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="302">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />302 - Source status changed</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="302">

This message is generated when the status value of a source is updated to be different from the current value.

- Data 1 Usage: Old Value
- Data 2 Usage: New Value
- Data 3 Usage: Effective Date; the effective date of the source characteristic record with the updated status
- Data 4 Usage: Not used
- Data 5 Usage: Not used
- Message Class: 3 (Information)
- Message Priority: 5 (Logged)

</div>
